SparkyFitness v1.12.0 is out! 🏋️‍♂️

The open-source fitness and nutrition tracker adds:
- Lab test result management with mobile screens 📋
- NFC tag logging for food and water
- Docker readiness endpoint, OpenCode GO AI support, and Wear OS build updates

Rolling out on PikaPods soon.

https://github.com/CodeWithCJ/SparkyFitness/releases/tag/v1.12.0
https://pikapods.com/pods?run=sparkyfitness

#opensource #privacy
